responsibility: Contains the primary RTL machine description for Blackfin, defining hard-register number constants, UNSPEC codes, instruction attributes, pipeline automata and reservations, and the bulk of instruction patterns that map GCC RTL operations onto Blackfin scalar and DSP instructions. It is the backend’s central generated-code specification for instruction selection, alternative encodings, scheduling types, and special patterns such as vector/DSP operations, unusual loads, branches, and included synchronization support.
same_name_distinction: This is the machine description source for Blackfin: it defines hard-register and UNSPEC constants, instruction attributes, pipeline reservations, and RTL insn patterns that drive instruction selection and scheduling. Unlike bfin.cc it is not procedural hook implementation code, unlike bfin.h it is not a C/C++ target-configuration header, and unlike bfin.opt it does not declare command-line options or target variables.
